title: Willow Interchange
description: A lower answer enters two beats after the upper melody, retaining its first two bars an octave below. The B-flat–A-flat–F–E-flat thought comes from Willow Arcade. Independent lines travel through G minor and E-flat before the tune returns above a new bass and the piece settles into open fifths.
difficulty: Intermediate to advanced delayed imitation and independent line shaping
technical_note: Hear the opening LH as an answer delayed by two quarter beats, rather than an accompaniment. Later replies become freer. Let the two lines release together only at the written shared rests.

performance.note: The initial two-beat echo gradually becomes a conversation. Shape both lines through their high points and retain the final bare fifths.

composition_time_source: Recorded when the first score was saved.

audio_reverb.description: Subtle warm room; preserve the clarity of moving voices.
